grandplace.name: Grand-Place
grandplace.slogan: Gold-trimmed guild houses around a square built twice.
grandplace.line: Marshal de Villeroy's French army bombarded it on 13 August 1695, and the square was rebuilt within four years.

atomium.name: Atomium
atomium.slogan: An iron crystal, blown up for a world's fair.
atomium.line: Built for Expo 58 to last six months, it shows an iron crystal magnified 165 billion times.

horta.name: Horta Museum
horta.slogan: A staircase that curls like a plant stem.
horta.line: Victor Horta lived and worked in this house, built 1898 to 1901; UNESCO listed it in 2000.

magrittemuseum.name: Magritte Museum
magrittemuseum.slogan: Bowler hats, green apples and a pipe that is not a pipe.
magrittemuseum.line: Opened in 2009 on Place Royale, it holds about 200 works, the biggest Magritte archive anywhere.

cinquantenaire.name: Cinquantenaire Arch
cinquantenaire.slogan: Three arches and a bronze chariot for fifty years of Belgium.
cinquantenaire.line: A temporary wooden arch stood from 1880; Leopold II pushed for the stone one, finished with private money in 1905.
